lyrics:
[Intro: pounding kick, struck metal, one bass sequence]

[Chant 1: shouted male voice, single words]
Sweat! Sweat!
Steel! Steel!
Breath! Breath!
Again! Again!

[Chant 2: second voice answering]
Lift it! (Lift it!)
Hold it! (Hold it!)
Lower! (Lower!)
Again! (Again!)

[Break: metal percussion only, counted]
One. Two. Three. Four.
Five. Six. Seven. Eight.

[Chant 3: both voices, bass doubled]
Sweat! Sweat!
Steel! Steel!
Breath! Breath!
Again! Again!

[Chant 4: crowd joining]
Reps! Reps! Reps! Reps!
One more! One more!
Reps! Reps! Reps! Reps!
One more!

[Break: kick only, gasped]
Nine. Ten.

[Final Chant: everyone, loudest]
Sweat! Steel! Breath! Again!
Sweat! Steel! Breath! Again!
Done.

[Outro: a weight set down, hard breathing]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 128 BPM, 4/4, D minor. Stark, pounding and muscular, with no harmony to speak of.

VOICE: Male, English, shouted from the chest in single words, hoarse and urgent. A second man answers. A crowd joins later. Counted numbers in the breaks. No singing.

INSTRUMENTS: A hard four-on-the-floor kick, struck scrap-metal percussion, a single syncopated analogue bass sequence, a cracking snare on two and four, a tom pattern in the breaks, the clank of a weight at the end.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, kick, metal and bass. 0:14 Chant 1. 0:36 Chant 2. 0:58 Break, counting. 1:14 Chant 3. 1:36 Chant 4, crowd. 1:58 Break, 'Nine. Ten.' 2:06 Final chant. 2:36 Outro, weight down and breathing, ends 2:56.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 1987 English EBM: minimal, dry and brutally loud, drums and one sequence, voice shouted in a hard room.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The gasped 'Nine. Ten.' at 1:58.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original borrows the sound of political slogans and empties them. This fills the same shape with the one mass movement most people joined later in life: counting repetitions.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Straining, driven, failing, done.
